{

      "fn": "check_new_payment_review_step",
      "description": "目标申请新增唯一的付款审核复核通过人工节点，操作人、任职、委托标志和稳定幂等标记均正确。",
      "ground_truth": {
        "request_id": "REQ-PAY-2024-0241",
        "sequence_no": 4,
        "step_code": "PAYMENT_REVIEW",
        "action_code": "APPROVE",
        "approver_assignment_id": "ASN-HE-PAYREV-202301",
        "actual_operator_person_id": "PERSON_HE_JIACHENG",
        "delegated_flag": 0,
        "action_comment_contains_idempotency_marker": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "request_status_in_review",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_request_status",
      "description": "目标付款申请登记复核通过后状态为处理中。",
      "ground_truth": {
        "request_id": "REQ-PAY-2024-0241",
        "request_status": "IN_REVIEW"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "historical_steps_unchanged",
      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_historical_steps_unchanged",
      "description": "原有三条历史审批节点保持不变，且未新增客户端系统归档动作。",
      "weight": 0
    },
    {
      "id": "timeline_conclusion",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "最终答复是否准确重建了该申请的人工处理顺序，并识别出先发生付款审核退回、后由应付会计补件，且明确排除了流程引擎自动归档记录？",
      "pass_anchor": "应明确说明 E9-PAY-2024-0241 的人工顺序是：序号1提交付款申请；序号2由付款审核环节退回，原因是缺少本批次检验报告签章页；序号3由应付会计补件，说明已上传检验报告、等待付款审核人复核。系统中若提到自动归档，只能作为被排除的系统动作，不能算人工审批。"
    },
    {
      "id": "reviewer_assignment_conclusion",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "最终答复是否识别出复核审核人的有效任职、实际身份与委托结论？",
      "pass_anchor": "应识别何嘉诚（规范身份 PERSON_HE_JIACHENG）使用 ASN-HE-PAYREV-202301，职责为 PAYMENT_REVIEWER/付款审核，任职自 2023-01-16 起有效且没有结束日；实际操作人与该任职匹配，delegated_flag=0，未发现可依据的委托关系。"
    },
    {
      "id": "operation_conclusion",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "最终答复是否说明已经完成了正确的数据库操作及其关键后态？",
      "pass_anchor": "应说明已在 REQ-PAY-2024-0241 追加唯一序号4的 PAYMENT_REVIEW/APPROVE 人工节点，由何嘉诚执行，未使用委托，并带有稳定幂等标记；申请状态已更新为 IN_REVIEW（处理中/复核中）。不应声称伪造或新增 SYSTEM_ARCHIVE。"
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "import re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nREQUEST_ID = \"REQ-PAY-2024-0241\"\nEXPECTED_HISTORY = [\n    (\"STP-PAY-0241-01\", \"PAYMENT_REQUEST_SUBMIT\", \"ASN-ZHOU-AP-202401\", \"PERSON_ZHOU_YINING\", \"SUBMIT\", 0, 1, \"提交APV-2024-04-00241付款申请。\"),\n    (\"STP-PAY-0241-02\", \"PAYMENT_REVIEW\", \"ASN-HE-PAYREV-202301\", \"PERSON_HE_JIACHENG\", \"RETURN\", 0, 2, \"缺少本批次检验报告签章页，请补充后再审。\"),\n    (\"STP-PAY-0241-03\", \"SUPPLEMENT_MATERIAL\", \"ASN-ZHOU-AP-202401\", \"PERSON_ZHOU_YINING\", \"SUPPLEMENT\", 0, 3, \"已上传检验报告，等待付款审核人复核。\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _db(ws):\n    ws = Path(ws)\n    candidates = [ws.parent / \"system\" / \"weaver_e9_approval\" / \"state.db\", Path(\"system/weaver_e9_approval/state.db\")]\n    for path in candidates:\n        if path.exists():\n            con = sqlite3.connect(path)\n            con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n            return con\n    raise FileNotFoundError(\"weaver_e9_approval/state.db not found\")\n\n\ndef _result(ok, detail):\n    return {\"score\": 1 if ok else 0, \"detail\": detail}\n\n\ndef check_new_payment_review_step(ws):\n    with _db(ws) as con:\n        rows = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM approval_steps WHERE request_id=? AND sequence_no=4\",\n            (REQUEST_ID,),\n        ).fetchall()\n    if len(rows) != 1:\n        return _result(False, f\"序号4节点数量为 {len(rows)}，应为1\")\n    row = rows[0]\n    checks = [\n        row[\"step_code\"] == \"PAYMENT_REVIEW\",\n        row[\"action_code\"] == \"APPROVE\",\n        row[\"approver_assignment_id\"] == \"ASN-HE-PAYREV-202301\",\n        row[\"actual_operator_person_id\"] == \"PERSON_HE_JIACHENG\",\n        row[\"delegated_flag\"] == 0,\n        bool(re.search(r\"\\[idem:[^\\]\\s]+\\]\", row[\"action_comment\"] or \"\")),\n    ]\n    if not all(checks):\n        return _result(False, \"序号4的节点类型、动作、审核人、委托标志或幂等标记不符合要求\")\n    return _result(True, \"已找到符合约束的唯一序号4付款审核通过节点\")\n\n\ndef check_request_status(ws):\n    with _db(ws) as con:\n        row = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT request_status FROM approval_requests WHERE request_id=?\",\n            (REQUEST_ID,),\n        ).fetchone()\n    ok = row is not None and row[\"request_status\"] == \"IN_REVIEW\"\n    return _result(ok, \"申请状态为 IN_REVIEW\" if ok else \"申请不存在或状态不是 IN_REVIEW\")\n\n\ndef check_historical_steps_unchanged(ws):\n    with _db(ws) as con:\n        rows = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT step_id,step_code,approver_assignment_id,actual_operator_person_id,action_code,delegated_flag,sequence_no,action_comment \"\n            \"FROM approval_steps WHERE request_id=? AND sequence_no<=3 ORDER BY sequence_no\",\n            (REQUEST_ID,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        archives = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM approval_steps WHERE request_id=? AND step_code='SYSTEM_ARCHIVE' AND action_code='SYSTEM'\",\n            (REQUEST_ID,),\n        ).fetchone()[\"n\"]\n    actual = [tuple(row) for row in rows]\n    ok = actual == EXPECTED_HISTORY and archives == 0\n    return _result(ok, \"原三条历史节点未改变且未新增系统归档动作\" if ok else \"历史节点被修改、删除或新增了系统归档动作\")\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "db",
  "act": "mutate_db",
  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}

rationale: Zero reward weight for rules measured passing on pristine state; keep the checks and failure reports.
